column1: # comment: "Tag alignments \u2014 SKOS, schema.org, Dublin Core, FOAF, W3C Web Annotation, MOAT and the Tag Ontology. The reified gmeow:Tagging relator (with provenance, confidence, temporal scope and suppression) is canonical; flat projections are lossy downcasts."

column6: MOAT distinguishes tag string from meaning URI; GMEOW's Tag IRI IS the meaning, with labels for synonyms
A GMEOW Tag is an open value-vocabulary individual, structurally close to a skos:Concept
GMEOW Tagging is a relator with provenance/confidence/temporal scope; oa:Annotation is a flatter annotation body — closeMatch, not exactMatch
Newman's Tag Ontology — GMEOW Tagging carries the same tripartite structure (tagger, resource, tag) with added provenance/confidence/temporal scope
GMEOW broaderTag is transitive; skos:broader is the direct link (skos:broaderTransitive is transitive) — closeMatch, not exactMatch
lossy — schema:keywords is a text or URL value; GMEOW hasTag points to a structured Tag individual
The tag is the body of the annotation; lossy — oa:hasBody may also be a textual body, a SpecificResource, etc.
